name: get_me
description: Returns the authenticated user's GitHub profile (name, login, email, company, plan).

name: get_teams
description: Returns the teams the authenticated user belongs to.

name: get_team_members
description: Lists members of a specific team.

name: search_code
description: Runs GitHub code search across every repository the token can read.

name: search_issues
description: Searches issues across repositories with GitHub's search qualifier syntax.

name: search_repositories
description: Searches public and accessible-private repositories.

name: search_users
description: Searches GitHub users by login, name, or email.

name: search_pull_requests
description: Searches pull requests across repositories.

name: get_file_contents
description: Returns the contents of a file (or a directory listing) at a given ref.

name: get_repository_tree
description: Returns the recursive tree of a repository at a specific ref.

name: get_commit
description: Returns a single commit by SHA.

name: list_commits
description: Lists commits on a branch.

name: list_tags
description: Lists tags in a repository.

name: list_branches
description: Lists all branches in a repository.

name: get_latest_release
description: Returns the latest release for a repository.

name: list_releases
description: Lists releases in a repository.

name: issue_read
description: Returns the details of a single issue.

name: list_issues
description: Lists issues in a repository.

name: pull_request_read
description: Returns the details of a single pull request.

name: list_pull_requests
description: Lists pull requests in a repository.

name: list_code_scanning_alerts
description: Lists CodeQL alerts in a repository.

name: list_secret_scanning_alerts
description: Lists secret-scanning alerts in a repository.

name: list_dependabot_alerts
description: Lists Dependabot vulnerability alerts.

name: list_discussions
description: Lists discussions in a repository or organisation.

name: list_notifications
description: Lists notifications for the authenticated user.

name: create_or_update_file
description: Creates a new file in a repo or replaces an existing one with a new commit.

name: push_files
description: Pushes multiple file changes atomically as a single commit on a branch.

name: create_branch
description: Creates a new branch from a given ref.

name: delete_file
description: Deletes a file from a repository by creating a deletion commit on the target branch.

name: fork_repository
description: Forks a repository into the authenticated user's namespace.

name: create_repository
description: Creates a new repository owned by the authenticated user or an organisation.

name: create_issue
description: Creates a new issue in the repository.

name: update_issue_body
description: Updates the body of an existing issue.

name: add_issue_comment
description: Adds a comment to an existing issue.

name: create_pull_request
description: Creates a new pull request from a head branch to a base branch.

name: update_pull_request
description: Updates fields on an existing pull request.

name: merge_pull_request
description: Merges an open pull request using merge, squash, or rebase strategy.

name: actions_run_trigger
description: Triggers a GitHub Actions workflow run via the workflow_dispatch event.

name: actions_get
description: Returns details for a single workflow run.

name: actions_list
description: Lists workflow runs in a repository.

name: get_job_logs
description: Returns the logs for a specific workflow job.

name: star_repository
description: Stars a repository as the authenticated user.

name: dismiss_notification
description: Marks a notification as read / dismissed.

name: create_gist
description: Creates a new gist (public or secret).
